The '''Republic Security Force''', also known as '''Republic Security''' or the '''Republic Guard''', was the primary [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]]. [[Police officer/Legends|Police officers]] with Republic Security were referred to as [[Republic Peace Officer]]s.

==Overview==
The Republic Security Force was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As part of the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] and answerable to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], Republic Security worked below the notice of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to fight crime but operated above local [[Planetary Security Forces]] which served under it.<ref name="BHPOSG" /> The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] was under the Republic Security Force.<ref name="BHPOSG" /> The [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] of Republic Security were referred to as [[Republic Peace Officer]]s. They were charged with enforcing Republic laws, issuing traffic citations, responding to emergency calls, and apprehending criminals.<ref name="CSWE" /> At times, Republic Security assisted the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where they would patrol in [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of five.<ref name="HAS1">[[Star Wars (1998) 28|''Star Wars'' (1998) 28]]</ref> Republic Peace Officers would also conduct raids on suspected criminal locations.<ref name="HAS2" />

==History==
[[File:DannlFaytonni-SWHC39.png|thumb|right|175px|Dannl Faytonni in a Republic Security uniform]]
Republic Security was in operation as early as the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="KOR9">[[Knights of the Old Republic 9|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 9]]</ref> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era, Republic Security issued warrants for several high-profile criminals included [[Rogun Matt'rik]], [[Nok Drayen]], and [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]].

In [[3643 BBY]], [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Amille Razna]] was in command of a group of [[Police officer/Legends|officers]] sent to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to put a halt to the violent scavenging that was occurring. During the investigation, Razna attempted to arrest a particular violent scavenger known as [[Locust]]. However, she and her team were captured by the gang until they were rescued later by an individual.<ref name="Fall of the Locust">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Fall of the Locust|Taris (Republic)}}</ref>

In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], the outlaw [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] ambushed and killed a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Unidentified Republic Peace Officer|Peace Officer]] and his squad who were on patrol on Coruscant.<ref name="HAS1" /> She later met the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] couple [[Tallet]] and [[Lekket]] who told her of a raid by Republic Security on their factory.<ref name="HAS2" />

Prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], infamous con artist [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]] impersonated a Republic Security officer on several occasions.<ref name="dfdb">{{DB|character|lieutenantfaytonni|Faytonni, Lieutenant Dannl}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Security Force first appeared in [[Star Wars: The Hunt for Aurra Sing (trade paperback)|''Star Wars: Republic: The Hunt for Aurra Sing comic series'']] which began publishing on [[March 28]], [[2001]] where they were mentioned as the Republic Guard. The also received an entry in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]'' published on [[May 1]], [[2002]]. They were named as the Republic Security Force in ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' a game developed by [[LucasArts]] and released on [[December 5]], [[2002]]. They also received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' published on [[December 9]], [[2008]] as the Republic Guard.
